definitions.explanation: The basic term for water in its liquid state. Used for drinking water, tap water, and water in general. For hot water, use お{湯|ゆ} (oyu).

examples.english: Please give me water. / Water, please.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}は{大切|たいせつ}です。

notes: {水|みず} specifically refers to cold or room-temperature water. Hot water is お{湯|ゆ} (oyu). In restaurants, water is typically served free and you can request it by saying 「お{水|みず}ください」(omizu kudasai) - adding お makes it more polite.
